items.title: US Dollar Price Forecast: DXY Holds Firm Ahead of NFP, Can GBP/USD and EUR/USD Recover?
items.summary: DXY holds above 101.76 as higher Treasury yields support the dollar, while EUR/USD and GBP/USD attempt recoveries ahead of September NFP.
